name: Semrush
summary: Semrush Analytics API: domain overviews, organic and paid keywords, keyword research and backlink reports.

api_key.description: a Semrush API key (Subscription info > API units in your Semrush account); it spends your API unit balance

notes: Every report is a GET with a type parameter naming the report; each endpoint here fixes it, and you must still send it (the enum has one value).
Reports answer CSV (semicolon-separated, header row), not JSON. Use export_columns to choose columns.
Billing is in API units per returned line, so always set display_limit; the default is up to 10,000 lines.
Backlink reports live under /analytics/v1/ instead of the root path; the unit balance check is on a separate http host and is not included.

endpoints.name: Domain overview across databases
endpoints.summary: Organic and paid search totals (rank, keywords, traffic, traffic cost) for a domain, one line per regional database.

type.description: The report type. Always domain_ranks for this call.

database.description: Regional database code. Unset returns about 140 lines, one per database you can access.

display_limit.description: Maximum lines returned. 0 or unset means 10,000 lines; the cap per call is 100,000 (use display_offset past that).

display_offset.description: Lines to skip before the report starts. Add it to display_limit.

export_columns.description: Comma-separated column codes to return. Unset sends the report's default columns. Known codes: Db, Dt, Dn, Rk, Or, Ot, Oc, Ad, At, Ac, Sh, Sv, FKn, FPn, Sr, Srb, St, Stb, Sc, Srn, Srl

display_sort.description: Sort order, a column code plus _asc or _desc. Known values: rk_asc, rk_desc, or_asc, or_desc, ot_asc, ot_desc, oc_asc, oc_desc, ad_asc, ad_desc, at_asc, at_desc, ac_asc, ac_desc

display_date.description: Month to report, as YYYYMM15. Unset returns the latest data. Asking for a past date bills the higher historical price.

notes: Answers CSV text, semicolon-separated with a header row, not JSON; export_columns picks the columns.
Costs 10 API units per line returned (50 per line for historical data). Without database, expect about 140 lines.
